purpose: Document paths excluded from the disposable RaytSystem Documents index by invariant policy.

exclusions.reason: Git object database and repository metadata are operational state, not source documents.
Hidden directories contain local caches, editor state, or tool metadata.
Third-party installed dependencies are reproducible and outside the source corpus.
Installed Python environments are reproducible dependency state.
Generated Python bytecode cache is not source content.
Generated build output is rebuildable and can duplicate source content.
Generated distribution output is rebuildable and can duplicate source content.
Coverage blobs are generated test telemetry and may exceed the 5 MiB per-file limit.
Test runner state and reports are operational evidence, not source documents.
Compiled Storybook output is generated and duplicates frontend source.
Graphify output is a generated projection and must never self-index.
Binary and compiled asset trees are not part of the text-first Documents corpus.
Generated component indexes and binary assets are rebuildable projections.
Static binary site assets are excluded from the text-first Documents corpus.
SQLite write-ahead log sidecars are volatile database state.
SQLite shared-memory sidecars are volatile database state.
SQLite rollback journals are volatile database state.
Environment files can contain credentials or deployment secrets.
Credential-named files are excluded by the non-overridable secret filename policy.
Secret-named files are excluded by the non-overridable secret filename policy.
Token-named files are excluded by the non-overridable secret filename policy.
Dependency lock files are reproducible package-manager state.
Dependency lock files are reproducible package-manager state.
Dependency lock files are reproducible package-manager state.
